name: 15005 · Baden, PA
findings: ZIP 15005 (Baden) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15005 (Baden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15005 (Baden) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
